title: Decompose Receipt
description: Extension fields for decompose-receipt.json. Extends receipt.base.schema.json.

wave_count.description: Number of waves in the produced wave plan

complexity_confirmed.description: Complexity level confirmed by Decompose (may differ from Recipe initial score if revised upward)

complexity_revised.description: True when Decompose revised complexity upward from Recipe's initial score

complexity_revision_reason.description: Required when complexity_revised = true. Explains why complexity was revised.

reviewer_triggered.description: True when wave plan was routed through Reviewer before Executor

reviewer_verdict.description: Reviewer verdict on the wave plan. Required when reviewer_triggered = true.

rollback_checkpoints.description: Number of rollback checkpoint targets declared across all waves. Wave 1 always has null rollback_to, so maximum = wave_count - 1.

collapse_applied.description: True when Low-complexity + collapse_eligible = true and waves were collapsed to single wave

wave_plan_path.description: Path to the written wave plan file

verification_modes.description: List of verification modes assigned, one per wave

waves_with_verification_command.description: Count of waves that declare a runnable verification_command. Must equal wave_count; a mismatch means at least one wave has no runnable verification command.
